question: The other day Wilhelm-san’s character design was made open to the public but it was mind numbing. What kind of thoughts did Neko-san have when you saw the design?
answer: Since it’s the story of his true self, it’s not an exaggeration if I say that the design is the most important one in the third arc. I am confident that I have the same thoughts as everyone. I am pleased with Otsuka-san.
